browser.unsupported: The in-app browser is only available on iOS and Android.
browser.title: Connect to {{host}}
browser.body: This site wants to see your address and ask you to sign. It can’t move funds without your approval.
browser.addFromSite: Not in Vela’s network list — the name and coin are the site’s.
browser.addRpcFromSite: Vela’s network list has no RPC it can use for this network, so the RPC is the site’s.
browser.addWhyNoRpc: Vela found no RPC it can use to check this network: it checks only over https, and the site gave none it can use.
browser.addWhyUnreachable: Vela couldn’t reach {{host}} to check it. The node may be down or slow, or may not let Vela in — local nodes often don’t.
browser.addUnverifiedWarning: Vela couldn’t check this network. If {{host}} isn’t chain {{chainId}}, or Vela’s contracts aren’t on it, money sent to your Vela address there could be stuck. Add it only if you run it or trust it.
browser.disconnectBody: The site will need to reconnect before it can see your address or ask you to sign.
browser.signedOut: You’re not signed in to Vela. Sign in with your passkey, or create a wallet, to continue.
browser.multisigNoMessagesTitle: A multisig can’t sign messages yet
browser.multisigNoMessagesBody: {{host}} asked this multisig to sign a message. A multisig’s signature needs its members’ approvals, which Vela doesn’t collect for messages yet, so the site will be told no. Transactions still work: they become proposals the members approve.
browser.multisigConnectNote: This is a multisig: the site can propose transactions for its members to approve, but it can’t ask it to sign messages.

signHandoff.returnHint: Return to Safari — this page won't refresh
signHandoff.oneTapHint: Signing in Safari will now open Vela directly. Tap ‹ Safari (top-left) to go back.

safariExt.heroBody: Almost any dApp can connect to Vela right in Safari — only signing hops to Vela for a quick Face ID.
safariExt.step1: Open a dApp site in Safari.
safariExt.step2: Tap “Aa” → Manage Extensions → turn on Vela Wallet.
safariExt.step4: In the site’s Connect Wallet list, pick Vela Wallet.
safariExt.oneTapBody: Face ID confirms, then you’re back on the page. Tap “Test one-tap signing” in the extension popup once and even the “Open in Vela?” prompt goes away.
